subject: Pricing schedule: safety bands & proration ladder for SKU migration
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Samuel Park <samuel.park@novusapp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Pricing schedule: safety bands & proration ladder for SKU migration

Hi Samuel,

Thanks again for taking the time on Friday. NovusApp's mid-quarter SKU migration creates a tricky billing footprint for Q4; based on the migration plan you shared we think the pricing exhibit needs two clarifications so downstream billing and legal are aligned:

1) Safety bands (caps/floors) when SKUs are deprecated mid-period — we propose a "proration ladder" approach rather than a single pro-rata line item so both sides can predict invoice exposure across partial months.

2) Billing signals and backfill credits — mapping between metering keys (old SKU -> new SKU) needs to be explicit to avoid double-counting during the migration.

I've attached an annotated Exhibit C (Exhibit-C_pricing_safetybands_v1.docx) with a suggested clause and sample math for a 3-week transition. Can you loop in your procurement/legal and Priya from billing for a quick validation?

Asks:
- Can Novus confirm if you'll accept a proration ladder (see p.2 of the attachment) or do you need a single pro rata clause?
- Any required wording from your legal team around "cap per SKU" vs "cap per customer"?

If we can get alignment this week we can update the order form and push the DocuSign for signature before the SKU cutover.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Exhibit-C_pricing_safetybands_v1.docx (annotated), metering_key_map.csv (reference)

From: Samuel Park <samuel.park@novusapp.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <billing@novusapp.com>, NovusApp Legal <legal@novusapp.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pricing schedule: safety bands & proration ladder for SKU migration

Evelyn — thanks for the clear write-up and the annotated exhibit. High level: Novus prefers predictability on our side, so a deterministic ladder that spells out weekly buckets is attractive. A couple items from our end:

- Can you provide 2-3 sample invoice scenarios (best / expected / worst) showing how a 40% migration in week 2 would flow through caps/floors?
- Legal flagged the phrase "cap per SKU" — they want a definition for "SKU" in the exhibit and prefer the cap to be expressed as "cap per billing metric (as defined in Schedule A)" so it's unambiguous.

Looping in Legal and Priya for commentary. We can do a call Wednesday morning PST if that's helpful.

—Samuel
Head of Cloud Ops, NovusApp

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samuel Park <samuel.park@novusapp.com>, NovusApp Legal <legal@novusapp.com>, Priya Rao <billing@novusapp.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T08:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pricing schedule: safety bands & proration ladder for SKU migration

Thanks Samuel — appreciate the preference for deterministic buckets. From a commercial / legal perspective I suggest the following edits to Exhibit C (inline bullets here) so procurement can sign without follow-ups: 

- Define "Billing Metric / SKU": '"Billing Metric' means the usage unit listed on the Order Form (e.g., tokens, embeddings, seats) and the associated SKU code mapping in Schedule A. The term 'SKU' when used in this Exhibit refers to the Billing Metric as mapped in the metering_key_map.csv.'

- Replace ambiguous cap language with this sentence: "Monthly cap means the maximum aggregate invoiced amount for Customer's Billing Metrics for the applicable calendar month, expressed per Billing Metric tier as set forth in Exhibit C."

- Proposed "Proration Ladder" clause (suggested text to insert under section 3):
  "If a Billing Metric or SKU is migrated, deprecated, or split during a billing month, the parties will apply the Proration Ladder: invoices will be computed using time-weighted buckets (Week 1, Week 2, Week 3, Week 4) with the applicable per-unit rates for each bucket. For partial weeks the proration factor shall be (days active in period / 7). The net invoice shall treat any overage against the applicable cap for that bucket; excess charges beyond the bucket cap will be eligible for backfill credits as described in Section 3.4."

- Legal asked to add an ops-exception if metering_key_map.csv can't be deterministic; add: "If metering key reconciliation cannot be completed within 30 days, the parties will use mutually-agreed reconciliation heuristics and create a one-time backfill/true-up invoice."

I've put brackets in the attached Word so legal teams can track the changes. If Novus prefers a single pro-rata line instead of the ladder, we should show comparative scenarios (I can have ops produce those).

Karthik Iyer
Sr. Manager, Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samuel Park <samuel.park@novusapp.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <billing@novusapp.com>, NovusApp Legal <legal@novusapp.com>
Date: 2026-11-17T09:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pricing schedule: safety bands & proration ladder for SKU migration

Samuel / team — attaching an operations mapping (metering_key_map.csv) and a short spreadsheet with three invoice scenarios: scenario-best.xlsx (best: 70% migration in week 4), scenario-expected.xlsx (40% migration in week 2), scenario-worst.xlsx (90% unexpected split). The Drive folder link is: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cEXAMPLE-PRICING

Notes:
- Our billing system can emit weekly usage buckets if the metering key mapping is provided ahead of the cutover (preferably 48 hours).
- If Novus needs us to treat the cutover as a single-day event we can, but it increases reconciliation manual work and delays invoice finalization by ~10 business days.

Attachments: metering_key_map.csv, scenario-best.xlsx, scenario-expected.xlsx, scenario-worst.xlsx

Marissa Cole
Sales Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Pricing schedule: safety bands & proration ladder for SKU migration

Thanks everyone — good progress. Next steps: 
- Novus legal: please review the edited Exhibit-C_pricing_safetybands_v1.docx (comments in red) and indicate acceptance or counter by EOD Tuesday PST.
- Priya / Novus billing: confirm whether you want "cap per Billing Metric" or "cap per customer" language (we can support either; picking one avoids ambiguity).
- Ops (Marissa/Karthik): if Novus confirms the ladder approach, let's schedule a 30-minute run-through Wednesday 10:00 AM PST to walk the scenarios and confirm metering key filenames.

If we get acceptance, I will prepare the clean Exhibit C for signature and route via DocuSign (link above).
